question: Do existing frozen-world one-shots show Z coupling beyond fine phase/transfer changes, in actual stereo pickup broad ERB-time/spectral-tail structure?

decision.rationale: The four pickups show partly repeated full and late signed ERB-band delta patterns, but native integrated and late-tail shape and fixed-gain tail energy remain nearly unchanged. Full-response distances overlap the natural-material range, and all Z distances are far below the prior contact-position variation.

implementationFact: The existing frozen seed-07 world render rows were reanalyzed; no new simulation or render was produced. The matched world-none shadow removes inter-layer Z-link arrays only; the world-z row restores those links.

shape.normalization: For each response and selected domain, divide pooled nonnegative linear ERB power by its total; diagnostic only.

full.method: Pearson correlation across 29 populated ERB-band signed Z-minus-none power-ratio dB profiles; six Plate pairs, descriptive only.

early.method: Pearson correlation across 29 populated ERB-band signed Z-minus-none power-ratio dB profiles; six Plate pairs, descriptive only.

late.method: Pearson correlation across 29 populated ERB-band signed Z-minus-none power-ratio dB profiles; six Plate pairs, descriptive only.

contextDistanceComparison.metric: 1 minus cosine similarity; within each prior response, pooled linear ERB power is unit-sum normalized; same transform and 30 bands.

representation.source: existing fixed-gain stereo PCM; no rerender
representation.bandOccupancyRule: FFT bin-center assignment using the reused helper; all 30 planned bands remain in the representation, while empty band 3 is omitted only from cross-Plate correlation and shared-sign counts.
representation.binBoundaryRule: half-open [low, high); frequency-bin centers mapped to equal ERB-rate bands; DC included in band zero
representation.dcTreatment: DC one-sided linear power is undoubled; included positive-frequency bins are doubled
representation.stereoPooling: mean left/right linear ERB-band power per frame before profiles, shape metrics, and dB conversion

nativeFixedGain.linearPower: |rFFT|^2/sum(Hann)^2; double positive-frequency bins except DC; sum bin power inside ERB band before dB

shapeOnlyDiagnostic.normalization: For each arm, divide the pooled linear ERB-time power over the compared domain by total power for that domain.

domains.integrated: sum over all frames into 30 bands
domains.lateTail: sum frames with left-aligned frame time >=500 ms into 30 bands

shapeOnlyDiagnostic.metric: cosine similarity; no power floor; separate from native fixed-gain levels; diagnostic only, not audibility evidence

controls.pairSourceConditionDifference: inter-layer Z-link arrays; the fixed-world generator source and equal schedule/material/pickup/topology metadata were checked

interpretationBoundary.researchInterpretation: Z is a property of this frozen stratigraphic network context, not an intrinsic property of any one Plate.

difference.scaleMethod: global 99.5th percentile of absolute Z-minus-none ERB-time dB ratios across four Plates
